incidents.title: Checkout API latency spike
incidents.impact: About 18% of checkout requests are timing out (p99 latency above 8s). Customers see 'payment failed' errors.

timeline.event: Alert fired: checkout-api p99 latency above 5s
Recent deploy v2.14.1 identified as a possible cause

runbook: Check the dashboard for error rate and p99 latency on checkout-api
Compare the start of the spike with the latest deploy (v2.14.1)
If the deploy correlates, roll back to v2.14.0
Check database connection pool saturation on payments-db
Post a status page update for customers

incidents.title: Search results returning stale data
incidents.impact: New products take up to 3 hours to appear in search. No errors, only delayed indexing.

timeline.event: Support reported missing new products in search
Indexer queue backlog found, consumers running at half capacity

runbook: Watch the queue drain and confirm new products appear
Open a follow-up ticket to fix consumer autoscaling
